name: IB Commission Tiers
when_to_pick: Show how an IB's (Introducing Broker's) earnings scale across volume or revenue-share tiers — the rate at each tier, what unlocks it, and an illustrative payout, with one tier flagged as the target/recommended tier. Pick it for IB & partnership content answering 'how much can I earn as an IB?', a rebate/commission rate card, or a Master-IB vs sub-IB split. For the IB org structure (who sits under whom) use hierarchy; for the IB recruitment drop-off use funnel; for an earnings what-if the reader computes live use calculator. Frame figures as illustrative examples, never promised income.

title.description: Optional heading, e.g. 'SignalBots IB rebate tiers (Forex, per standard lot)'.

threshold_label.description: Label for what unlocks each tier — change it for non-volume models (e.g. 'Referred traders', 'Deposits').

payout_label.description: Label for the per-tier illustrative earnings figure.

tiers.description: Ordered tiers from entry to top, left to right.

threshold.description: What unlocks this tier, e.g. '0-100 lots / mo'.

rate.description: The earning rate at this tier (the focal number), e.g. '$4.0 / lot' or '25% rev-share'.

payout.description: Optional illustrative earnings at this tier, e.g. 'about $2,000 / mo'.

recommended.description: Flag the target/recommended tier — gets an accent highlight + badge. Set on at most one tier.

caption.description: Optional one-line takeaway under the ladder.
